app_info.subtitle: Deploy and migrate web apps
app_info.description: Staticbot helps users deploy websites, manage deployment DNS and updates, migrate application backends to Supabase, operate continuous sync, and find available migration support routes through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the caller's account, organization, plan and connection state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change an integration or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or reuses a private workspace scan and queues bounded website analysis.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches the requested public website and related public resources through the guarded scanner.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify the scanned website, start a migration, deploy an app or delete data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the customer summary of a scan belonging to the current organization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the organization's available Staticbot templates.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the selected template's configuration, returning non-secret location values while credential-shaped values remain redacted.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private Staticbot template by scanning the specified GitHub repository.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only creates private Staticbot configuration and does not modify the GitHub repository.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a template without deleting or overwriting existing resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the organization's infrastructure stacks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the selected stack's configuration, returning non-secret location values while credential-shaped values remain redacted.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private Staticbot stack with template, domain, and integration configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not provision infrastructure, publish a website, or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a stack without deleting or overwriting existing resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves deployments, optionally filtered by stack.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a prepared deployment record that must be started separately.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not provision infrastructure or publish the prepared deployment.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a deployment record without deleting or overwriting resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a provisioning workflow for the prepared deployment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can provision infrastructure and publish a website to the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates deployment resources without offering a delete or irreversible removal action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves deployment progress, failures, and DNS requirements.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes deployment-owned certificate and routing records to the linked Cloudflare zone.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes live DNS records that affect how a public domain resolves.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite live deployment-owned DNS records, although it never changes nameservers or mail records and requires an exact eligible domain ID.

justifications.read_only_justification: Requests a new Cloudflare hostname validation attempt and refreshes stored verification state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can change external certificate and custom-hostname verification state in Cloudflare.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter DNS records, nameservers, or user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves supported AWS hosting choices for the current organization and optional stack.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves which Cloudflare accounts the organization may host an app in.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only validates a hosting choice and hostname; it does not create or change anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves automatic-update settings for a deployment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates private automatic-deployment settings in Staticbot.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private configuration and does not immediately publish or modify an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Settings can be changed again and omitted fields retain their existing values.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves automatic-update availability and webhook status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create a webhook or change another system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves valid commit-pinned rollback targets for a deployment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change the deployed website or another external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a deployment that replaces the currently served website with a selected earlier version.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes the version served on the public website.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces the live version and requires an exact target returned by list_rollback_versions plus explicit confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Rebuilds and redeploys the website, optionally after selecting the latest template version.
justifications.open_world_justification: Replaces the build served on the public website.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the currently served build with the requested redeployment.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves migrations, optionally filtered by status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a migration or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves migration status, phases, conflicts, gates, next actions, and available human-support routes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a migration or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a migration-owned, stored website scan summary.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not fetch the website again or modify any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not approve work or alter stored migration data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores the user-selected live URL by creating a migration-linked scan.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches the requested public website through the existing guarded scanner.
justifications.destructive_justification: Retains scan history and does not change the scanned site or start target migration writes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the latest retained live-commit comparison.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not perform a fresh Git fetch or change a repository.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter branches, deployments or migration state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the stored deterministic preview evidence, preserving failed and unverified checks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the sanitized discovery proposal and its approval blockers.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues an explicitly authorized fresh source inspection and records updated discovery evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can deploy the explicitly authorized source export helper and inspect the connected source system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not approve target migration writes or delete customer data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves retained discovery revision metadata for the current organization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the selected retained, sanitized discovery revision.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the sanitized migration handoff report and current execution evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves retained, sanitized execution revision evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves sanitized job-attempt and amendment history for the migration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Approves discovery or a selected migration strategy and allows target writes to begin.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can apply schema, data, storage, functions, and configuration to connected external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can apply irreversible target changes after the discovery inventory and any pre-flight choice are explicitly reviewed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues a fresh check (Cloud Data export, target capacity, or target emptiness) and records the result on the migration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the source project through its deployed export function, or the connected target Supabase project.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only measures; does not confirm or start the migration, and never writes to the source or target.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only inspects the current target-cleanup eligibility, scope and confirmation requirements.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes the explicitly selected database, authentication, or Storage scope from a connected Supabase target.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes data in the user's external Supabase project.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the approved target scope and requires the exact returned project reference plus explicit confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Releases paused migration work so queued jobs can continue.
justifications.open_world_justification: Continued jobs can write migrated resources to connected external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: The migration can be paused again and this action does not itself delete data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the migration's private state to prevent new jobs from starting.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not modify a public or external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: The migration can be resumed later and the current job is allowed to finish.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the migration review configuration only when the user explicitly requests it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes private Staticbot configuration without starting or approving external work.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove resources or approve pending writes; the setting can be changed again.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves migration jobs, progress, and failure details.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change migration work or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves which secrets a migrated app uses and whether each has a value — names and states, never a value.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change migration work or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Resets a failed migration job and queues it to run again.
justifications.open_world_justification: The retried job can write migration changes to connected external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only retries work that already failed and does not skip or delete it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Marks a blocking job skipped and allows dependent migration jobs to proceed.
justifications.open_world_justification: Dependent jobs can continue changing connected external systems after the skip.
justifications.destructive_justification: The skipped work is never performed and cannot be unskipped through another tool.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves deployments associated with the migration's stack.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change deployments or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private migration and begins source discovery, including Firebase migrations that do not require a repository template.
justifications.open_world_justification: Discovery reads source systems and pauses for approval before target writes begin.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not apply target changes until a later explicit confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a time-limited package URL and its extraction password.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not modify the package, migration, or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Marks a READY manual job complete and can attach user-approved DDL for the dependent schema-application job.
justifications.open_world_justification: Dependent migration jobs can apply the approved schema or other migration changes to connected external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: The manual completion and approved DDL cannot be withdrawn through this tool after the migration pipeline advances.

justifications.read_only_justification: Commits the migration to the user's selected automated or manual data-import path.
justifications.open_world_justification: The automated path can write data, Storage, authentication, functions, and configuration to Supabase.
justifications.destructive_justification: The selected path advances the migration and requires the user to choose after reviewing both options.

justifications.read_only_justification: Commits the migration to the user's selected backend-switchover strategy.
justifications.open_world_justification: Some choices create repository changes or alter which external backend the application uses.
justifications.destructive_justification: The choice can replace environment configuration or permanently skip switchover and must be explicitly selected by the user.

justifications.read_only_justification: Commits the migration to continuous sync, a Staticbot deployment, or a skipped frontend deployment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Some choices create deployment or synchronization changes in external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: The selection advances or permanently skips frontend deployment and must be explicitly chosen by the user.

justifications.read_only_justification: Checks the Supabase export function and, when it is reachable, completes the migration's READY sync step.
justifications.open_world_justification: Completing the sync step lets dependent migration jobs read source data and write it to the target Supabase.
justifications.destructive_justification: The step completion cannot be withdrawn through this tool once the migration pipeline advances; it only happens after the deployed function answers an authenticated ping.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the organization's connected integration instances.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change an integration or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves repositories available through the selected source-control integration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not modify any repository or another external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves repositories available through the selected GitHub integration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not modify any GitHub repository or another external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves projects available through the selected Supabase integration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not modify any Supabase project or another external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves organizations available through the selected Supabase integration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not modify a Supabase organization or another external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the supported region catalog for Supabase project creation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not modify a Supabase project or another external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a project in the user's explicitly selected Supabase organization and region after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates an external Supabase resource that can consume account quota or affect billing.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new project without deleting or overwriting existing resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the lifecycle state of the selected Supabase project.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not modify the Supabase project or another external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves apps available through the selected, organization-owned Base44 integration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves connected projects, optionally filtered by sync mode.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a connected project or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the selected connected project's sync and deployment details.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a connected project or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves tracked branches and their existing ephemeral preview state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change a public website or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, replace, approve or execute customer resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a synchronization run for the selected connected project.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can apply repository changes to Supabase and the project's deployed frontend.
justifications.destructive_justification: Starts a bounded sync workflow whose destructive database changes pause for separate review.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves synchronization history for a connected project.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not start or modify a synchronization run.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves status, versions, changes, and errors for a sync run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not start or modify a synchronization run.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the individual jobs belonging to a sync run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not start or modify synchronization work.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Approves or skips reviewed destructive database changes in a paused sync run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can apply SQL and other synchronization changes to connected external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can drop or rewrite target data and is only used after the destructive changes are surfaced for review.

justifications.read_only_justification: Resets failed sync jobs and reopens the run for another attempt.
justifications.open_world_justification: The retried run can write changes to Supabase and the deployed frontend.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only retries previously failed work and does not skip or delete it.

justifications.read_only_justification: Marks every failed job in the sync run completed without applying that work.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reopens the run, so its remaining jobs can apply changes to the connected Supabase project and the deployed frontend.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently skips the failed work after the tool description requires explanation and explicit confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves migrations that continuous sync never applied to the project's database.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates the connected project's private continuous-sync mode.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not immediately synchronize or modify an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: The sync mode can be changed again after user confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves current branch targets, role permissions and shared webhook scope.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Staticbot records without changing a repository or public site.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute or approve an operation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues a new or refreshed preview build after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can provision preview infrastructure and publish a preview site.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can replace an existing preview; explicit build confirmation is required.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the live branch and can queue a live redeployment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can redeploy the public website from the builder branch.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stops mirror maintenance and can replace the live build; explicit confirmation and matching branch targets are required.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues a preview-to-live merge or returns the already running sync.
justifications.open_world_justification: The worker can write Git commits and trigger preview builds.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can modify the live branch; explicit confirmation and matching inspected branch targets are required.

justifications.read_only_justification: Registers a repository webhook using server-held credentials.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a GitHub webhook affecting push-triggered automation for its shared consumers.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a webhook without replacing an existing one; the inspected repository scope must be explicitly confirmed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces stored webhook configuration and rotates the server-held secret.
justifications.open_world_justification: Requests upstream webhook deletion and registers a replacement on GitHub.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces a repository-wide webhook shared by projects or templates; explicit confirmation of the inspected configuration is required.

justifications.read_only_justification: Clears stored webhook configuration and requests upstream deletion.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can delete the GitHub webhook and stop push-triggered automation for all shared consumers.
justifications.destructive_justification: Removes webhook configuration; the exact inspected repository and shared scope require explicit confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or retrieves a preview deployment for the selected migration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can build and publish a reachable preview on Staticbot infrastructure.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a preview without deleting or overwriting the production deployment.

justifications.read_only_justification: Either queues a source-schema recheck or aborts the migration as explicitly selected by the user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads source state or changes the private migration state without writing externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: The abort option permanently ends the migration, with recheck offered as the safe alternative.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the Staticbot templates available for deploying my website.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns available templates with identifiers, names, categories, and repository links.

test_cases.description: Inspect a deployment and its DNS requirements.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check my selected Staticbot deployment and tell me its progress and any DNS action I need to take.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns deployment status and explains each domain's required DNS action without making DNS changes.

test_cases.description: Inspect the next action for a migration.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the status and next required action for the Staticbot migration we selected.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns migration phases, pending action, relevant review gates, failure information, and any available human-support route.

test_cases.description: Filter connected projects by a paused sync mode.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my Staticbot connected projects whose continuous sync is paused.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only connected projects in PAUSED sync mode with enough detail to select one.

test_cases.description: Analyze a public website before choosing hosting or migration.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check https://staticbot.dev and explain its detected platform and supported hosting or migration paths. Do not deploy or migrate anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts or reuses a workspace scan. While QUEUED or RUNNING, polls get_website_scan with the returned scan ID and pollAfterMs. On completion explains the reported platform, framework, backend and available paths, preserving estimate qualifiers. Reports access or rate-limit failures without bypassing them; never creates a migration or deployment.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a general programming explanation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain the difference between server-side rendering and static site generation.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not require Staticbot account data or an operation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated GitHub repository edit.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rename the default branch in my GitHub repository.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide general GitHub repository administration.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for domain registration or purchasing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy and register example.com for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because Staticbot can configure deployment DNS but cannot purchase or register domains.
